query: Turn this into a checklist I can track

steps.title: Verify Deadlines
steps.primary_action: Open the program advisors page and note your program's deadline for your target term.
steps.details: Application periods open July 1 (spring) and August 1 (fall, submissions start October 1). Not all programs admit each term.
prep: Your target start term (Fall or Spring)
how: Open https://www.csulb.edu/graduate-studies/graduate-programs-and-academic-advisors
Find your program in the list
Note the deadline for your target term
steps.outcome: You'll know the exact date your application is due.
warnings: Not all programs admit every term — confirm your program's specific deadline before applying.

steps.title: Submit University Application
steps.action: Apply through the Cal State Apply portal
steps.primary_action: Create your Cal State Apply account and start filling out the form.
steps.details: Complete Cal State Apply Graduate application. $70 nonrefundable fee. No fee waivers available.
prep: An email address you check often
Names and emails of recommenders (if your program requires letters)
how: Go to https://www.calstate.edu/apply
Create an account or sign in
Choose 'Graduate' and select CSULB
Fill out personal info, education history, and program selection
Upload required documents
Pay the $70 fee
Submit before your deadline
steps.outcome: You'll get a confirmation email with your CSULB ID. Admissions begins reviewing.

steps.title: Submit Official Transcripts
steps.action: Have your transcripts sent to CSULB
steps.primary_action: Email your previous registrar today — transcripts often take 1–4 weeks.
steps.details: Master's: bachelor's institution and most recent school. Doctoral: also need master's transcripts. Email: ES-IDPTrans@csulb.edu
prep: Knowledge of every college you attended
how: Contact the registrar at every college you attended
Request an OFFICIAL transcript (electronic preferred)
Have it sent to ES-IDPTrans@csulb.edu (or mailed to CSULB Enrollment Services)
steps.time: 1 hour to request; 1–4 weeks to arrive
steps.outcome: Your transcripts arrive at CSULB and are matched to your application.
warnings: Transcripts must be sent directly from your institution. Student-submitted copies are not accepted.

steps.title: Complete Program-Specific Requirements
steps.action: Finish your program's extra application items
steps.primary_action: Open Cal State Apply and check your program's supplemental section.
steps.details: Most programs require supplemental applications beyond the university application.
prep: Any extra documents your program lists (writing samples, portfolio, GRE scores, etc.)
how: Log back into Cal State Apply
Find the supplemental section for your program
Upload any extra documents your program requires
Submit before the program's deadline
Need help writing your Statement of Purpose? → https://www.csulb.edu/graduate-center/writing-a-statement-of-purpose
Need help with your CV or résumé? → https://www.csulb.edu/graduate-center/writing-a-cv-or-resume-for-graduate-school
CSULB undergrad, alum, or prospective student: request a one-on-one appointment with a Graduate Center Coordinator → https://www.csulb.edu/graduate-center/graduate-school-support
Upload drafts for written feedback via the Graduate Center's materials feedback service → https://csulb.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_eerjJlu6eVLBv2C
Or attend Graduate Center drop-in hours → https://www.csulb.edu/graduate-center
Current CSULB student (grad or undergrad): request an appointment with the University Writing Center (UWC) → https://www.csulb.edu/university-writing-center
Current CSULB graduate student: request an appointment with the Graduate Writing Specialist → https://www.csulb.edu/graduate-center/request-writing-appointment
Graduate Writing Specialist's grad admissions resources → https://thegraduatewritingguy.com/getting-into-grad-school/
steps.time: Varies — 1–6 hours depending on what's required
steps.outcome: Your application becomes complete and is forwarded to your department.

glossary.supplemental: extra application materials beyond the main Cal State Apply form

steps.title: Check Application Status
steps.action: Track your application status in MyCSULB
steps.primary_action: Log into MyCSULB and open the Admissions tile.
steps.details: Admissions reviews for minimum eligibility, then forwards to academic departments.
prep: Your CSULB ID (sent in your application confirmation email)
how: Log into MyCSULB Student Center
Check the 'Admissions' tile for status updates
Watch your CSULB email for follow-up requests
steps.outcome: You'll see one of: under review, admitted, denied, or 'documents needed'.

steps.title: Accept Admission Offer
steps.primary_action: Log into MyCSULB and click 'Accept' on your admission offer.
steps.details: Log into MyCSULB Student Center to accept or decline. Pay enrollment deposit (may be waived for financial need).
prep: Payment method for the enrollment deposit
how: Log into MyCSULB Student Center
Open your admission offer
Click 'Accept'
Pay the enrollment deposit (or request a waiver if you have financial need)
steps.outcome: Your spot in the program is reserved and you can begin enrolling.

glossary.enrollment deposit: a deposit (usually small) to reserve your seat — applied to first-term tuition

steps.title: Satisfy Admission Terms
steps.action: Submit any items required after admission
steps.primary_action: Re-read your admission letter, identify your admission type (Provisional or Conditionally Classified), and meet the deadline.
steps.details: Provisional admits: submit final transcripts by August 15 (fall) or January 15 (spring). Conditionally Classified: complete prerequisites.
how: Re-read your admission letter to find your admission type (Provisional or Conditionally Classified)
Provisional Admission: request your final official transcript from your bachelor's/master's institution
Have it sent directly to CSULB Enrollment Services by August 15 (Fall) or January 15 (Spring)
Conditionally Classified: enroll in and complete required prerequisite courses as directed by your department
Contact your department to confirm your status has been updated to 'Classified' once conditions are met
steps.time: 1 hour to arrange transcript; 1–4 weeks to arrive
steps.outcome: Your admission status is confirmed — Provisional converts to Classified, or prerequisites are cleared.

glossary.provisional: admitted but you must finish your bachelor's degree first
glossary.conditionally classified: admitted but with prerequisites you must complete
glossary.classified: fully admitted with no remaining conditions

steps.title: Appeal Process
steps.primary_action: Only appeal if you have new, compelling information — submit the online form within 15 days.
steps.details: Appeals rarely successful. Must include new, serious, and compelling information submitted within 15 days of decision.
prep: New, serious, and compelling information not in your original application
how: Read your denial letter carefully — note the specific reason for denial
Gather new, serious, and compelling evidence not included in your original application; include supporting documentation
Complete the Admissions Appeal Process form at https://es-forms.es.csulb.edu/forms/ADAPPL.php — no hard copy, email, or fax accepted
Submit within 15 days of receiving your admissions decision — late appeals are not accepted
You cannot appeal being waitlisted or your position on a waitlist
Allow 4–6 weeks for a response; maximum one appeal per academic term
Residency decision appeals: es-residency@csulb.edu
Applied through Bob Murphy Access Center? Contact https://www.csulb.edu/node/527261 at (562) 985.4430
steps.time: 2–3 hours to prepare; reviewed within 4–6 weeks
steps.outcome: You'll receive a written decision within 4–6 weeks (most appeals are denied).
warnings: Appeals are rarely successful and must include new, serious, and compelling information.
